summary: Resizes and positions an input image into the Common page output resolution using fit, justify, transform, and background controls.

key_params.name: fit
key_params.note: Fit mode: fill, fithorz, fitvert, fitbest, fitoutside, or nativeres

common_gotchas: Fill stretches or squashes; Fit Best preserves aspect inside; Fit Outside fills and crops.
Native Resolution does not scale and can be cropped by smaller outputs.
Transform results depend on pivot and transform order.
Common output resolution must be set intentionally because Fit TOP targets that resolution.
key_concepts: Fit TOP resizes input imagery to the output resolution set on the Common page.
Fit modes choose between stretching, fitting inside, filling/cropping outside, or native resolution.
Justification positions the fitted image after scale decisions are made.
Transform order, translation, rotation, scale, and pivot can further adjust the image.
Background color fills exposed areas where the fitted image does not cover the output.
Legacy Transform changes transform math and should be treated as compatibility behavior.
